name: categories_by_age_group
viewQuery:
SELECT
    (ROW_NUMBER() OVER()) as id,
    ag.name AS age_group,
    s.name  AS section,
    c.name  AS category
FROM age_group ag
JOIN category_age_group cag
    ON cag.age_group = ag.id
JOIN category c
    ON c.id = cag.category
JOIN section s
    ON s.id = c.section
ORDER BY
    ag.name,
    s.name,
    c.name ASC;

name: short_codes
viewQuery:
SELECT
  category.id,
  category.section,
  category.name,
  category.short_code
FROM category
WHERE category.active = 1

name: table_cards
viewQuery:
SELECT
  category_age_group.id as id,
  category.section,
  category_age_group.category,
  category_age_group.age_group,
  category.short_code
FROM category_age_group
JOIN category ON category.id = category_age_group.category
WHERE category.active = 1
